newsitem.title: USA: Nord Resources to arrange financing package.
newsitem.headline: Nord Resources to arrange financing package.

text.p: Nord Resources Corp said on Monday that its Sierra Rutile Ltd unit is negotiating a new financing package for rehabilitation and expansion programs as well as a restructuring of its existing debt.

The company, which owns 50 percent of Sierra Rutile, said there is no assurance that the talks will be successful, but it anticipates that it could restructe its finances by July 1997. Rutile is a premium titanium disoxide mineral.
Sierra Rutile's operations were suspended since January 1995 due to civil disturbances in West Africa's Sierra Leone, the company said.
Nord Resources and Sierra Rutile aim to rehabilitate the company's assets, resume production of rutile and complete an expansion program, when financing is received, the company said.
